hypotheses.paper: M a singular flat spacetime (def:singular_spacetime, l.1500-1505: a connected E_A-manifold, A = R_+, with the causality generated by its X_A-atlas)
hypotheses.note: the witness satisfies the library's class C.SingularFlatSpacetime (SFALocalE0.sing M) (singularFlatSpacetime, from SFALine.singularFlatAxioms_e0 plus connectedness). In the readings DEC-25 (structure), OQ-18 (natural causality), OQ-34/OQ-35 (E_0 = Causal.E0) and OQ-82 (Flat.isom 2), M = E_0 minus a point of the axis is a connected E_0-manifold (e0Covered), hence an E_{>=0}-manifold over the whole family (isoChartsCoverDEC25), with its natural causality (IsE0Natural, unique). It is also T2, second countable (subtype instances), causal (isCausal) and absolutely minimal (IsE0Natural's third clause)

StronglyCausal, DEC-7's form (stronglyCausal), which is what CupCapBTZAsPrinted asks; also the open form StronglyCausalOpen (stronglyCausalOpen), so the witness refutes the printed lemma in either reading of OQ-8

hypotheses.paper: p in sing_0(M), p_n -> p, p not in J^-(p_n) for every n (l.1827-1828)
hypotheses.note: p = (1, 0) on the axis, p_n = (1, 1/(n+1)) regular, f(p_n) = 1 - 1/(2(n+1)) < tau(p) = 1, so p is not <= p_n in E_0, hence not in M (failure)

hypotheses.paper: conclusion: union over N of the intersection over n >= N of J^-(p_n) equals J^-(p) minus {p} (l.1829)
hypotheses.note: z = (-1, 0) is in the left side (z << p_n for every n) and not in the right side (failure). Exactly J^-(p) = ]w, p] (Jminus_p); every axis point of M with tau < 1 is in the left side (axis_subset_iUnion_iInter), so the whole half-line below w is in the left side and not in the right side (halfLine_subset_diff)

findings: lem:cup_cap_BTZ as printed (ETT.tex:1825-1829, strongly causal M) is false, and this is now a theorem, not a finding by hand. Witness: M = E_0 minus w, w = (0, 0) on the BTZ line, with the structure pulled back along the inclusion (opensSingularGXStructure) and its natural causality C (any C with SFALocalE0.IsE0Natural C; it exists and is unique). Causal.CupCapBTZCounterexample.not_cupCapBTZAsPrinted proves ¬ C.CupCapBTZAsPrinted (SFALocalE0.sing M), the strict Prop of Causal/SingularGeroch.lean:326 itself, not a variant. not_forall_cupCapBTZAsPrinted refutes the Prop quantified over every space. M is connected, T2, second countable, causal, absolutely minimal, strongly causal in DEC-7's form and with open neighbourhoods, and a singular flat spacetime in the library's class. Data: p = (1, 0) in sing_0(M); p_n = (1, 1/(n+1)) -> p, regular, p not in J^-(p_n); z = (-1, 0). Then z << p_n for every n, while J^-(p) = ]w, p] (Jminus_p). So z is in the left side of l.1829 and not in the right side, and so is the whole half-line of the axis below w (halfLine_subset_diff).

The two provisos of the by-hand finding (curation paper_findings of lem:cup_cap_BTZ: « granted that E_0 is strongly causal and p ∈ Int J^+(z) ») are no longer provisos. Strong causality of E_0 is proved (E0.stronglyCausal, E0Strong.lean:759) and carried to every open subset of E_0 (stronglyCausal_opens). The interior fact is not used: z << p_n holds for every n directly. The chronological curve is the straight segment between developments of z and p_n (E0.clt_of_seg), whose radial coordinate is s * r(p_n), so it meets the axis only at z. The same finding (« by hand, not formalized: the library has no E_0 ») stands in the docstrings of Causal/SingularFlat.lean:104-113 and Causal/SingularGeroch.lean:312-325 and in the row's curation; those texts are now out of date.

What fails is exactly the hypothesis of Causality.cup_cap_BTZ_of_isClosed (SingularFlat.lean:566): J^+(z) is not closed in M (not_isClosed_Jplus_z: p_n ∈ J^+(z), p_n -> p, p ∉ J^+(z)). Consistently with DEC-19, M is not globally hyperbolic (not_globallyHyperbolic, the contrapositive of cupCapBTZAsPrinted_of_globallyHyperbolic). This locates the gap in the proof « as in the proof of Lemma lem:J_int » (l.1832). That proof (l.1805-1809) reduces to a chart around p that is causally convex in M, but the inclusion ⊂ of l.1829 needs z <= p_n ⇒ z <= p for points z far from p. That is the closedness of J^+(z), a global property that strong causality does not give. The strongest true form is the DEC-19 form, already certified (cupCapBTZAsPrinted_of_globallyHyperbolic; more generally cup_cap_BTZ_of_isClosed when every J^+(z) is closed; the ⊇ half with no hypothesis on M, SingularPastAt.Jminus_diff_subset_iUnion_iInter).

Roadmap, not the paper (the planner's [r] route, checked). Every cited location is correct: GXSingularDEC25.lean:265, :268, :272, :279; SFALine.lean:350; SFALocalE0.lean:201; E0Causality.lean:794, :802; E0Axioms.lean:486, :504; E0Strong.lean:759; SingularFlat.lean:104-113; SingularGeroch.lean:312-325. Step 1 (« no lemma says so yet ») is inexact. The strict bridge isAEChart_of_isAEMorphism_of_isLocalHomeomorph (GXSingularDEC25.lean:813), applied to isAEMorphism_opensSingular_val and the open embedding Subtype.val (hfe by rfl), gives the IsAEChart in one line (isAEChart_subtypeCoe, for any non-empty open subset of any singular (G,X)-manifold). aeAtlas_opensSingular is not needed. Step 2 is confirmed. The second clause of IsE0Natural makes the inclusion a ChartIso, with chartImage incl ⊤ = U, so C.le ⊤ = E0.causality.le U (relations_top_iff). Strong causality pulls back E_0's causally convex neighbourhood, because le_U ⊆ le_⊤ (le_mono); this is DEC-7's form, and the open form also holds. Step 3 is confirmed with a simpler argument (see the second finding); E0.Iminus_axis is not needed. Step 4 is confirmed: the curve's τ passes 0 by the intermediate value theorem (intermediate_value_Icc on CurveOn.continuousOn), and the point there is on the axis by E0.le_axis_iff', so it is w. Connectedness: isConnected_compl_singleton_of_one_lt_rank, rank_ℝ(ℝ × ℂ) = 3.
questions: Is an E_0-manifold (charts into E_0 and Minkowski space only) a « singular flat spacetime » in the sense of def:singular_spacetime (l.1500-1505)? That term is defined for A = R_+ (« we simply say singular flat spacetime when A = R_+ »). Reading taken: an E_A-manifold is an E_{A'}-manifold for A ⊂ A', as the library's family reading has it. The witness satisfies IsoChartsCoverDEC25 over the whole family massAModelCausality (isoChartsCoverDEC25), and its family sing equals SFALocalE0.sing (sing_family_eq). The refutation of the library's Prop does not depend on this reading. Most likely this is covered by OQ-18/DEC-25 and needs no new OQ row; the master decides.

kb_proposals: An open subset U of a singular (G,X)-manifold, with opensSingularGXStructure: its inclusion U.openPartialHomeomorphSubtypeCoe hU is an IsAEChart in one line, isAEChart_of_isAEMorphism_of_isLocalHomeomorph (isAEMorphism_opensSingular_val U) U.isOpen.isOpenEmbedding_subtypeVal.isLocalHomeomorph rfl (Causal.CupCapBTZCounterexample.isAEChart_subtypeCoe). Composing with M's charts gives E0Covered U from E0Covered M (e0Covered_opens). For U open in E_0 with its natural causality, the relations at ⊤ are E_0's in U (relations_top_iff, via chartImage_subtypeCoe_top). Strong causality (both forms), causality and, when U is connected, SingularFlatSpacetime pass to U (stronglyCausal_opens, stronglyCausalOpen_opens, isCausal_opens, singularFlatSpacetime_opens). The instance on ↥U needs attribute [local instance] E0GX.singularGX in scope; the type is ↥U itself (CupCapBTZAsPrinted is a Prop on a type, so kb/0001's no-subtype convention gives way here).

A causal curve of E_0 into a BTZ point stays on the axis, and its τ is continuous (CurveOn.continuousOn), so it cannot jump over an axis point: by intermediate_value_Icc it hits the point of the axis at any intermediate τ. This is how to show ¬ E0.causality.le W x p when W omits an axis point between them (CupCapBTZCounterexample.not_le_pE_of_fst_nonpos). Conversely, a straight segment of developments from an axis point x to a regular y has radial coordinate s * r(y) (E0.rad_unlift, E0.seg_snd_fst), so it meets the axis only at x (lt_of_mem_axis).
